reaction.notes: Updated using reported HTE trends: top-performing condition families across many discovery plates favor dtbpf- or dialkylbiaryl-phosphine–Pd systems with aqueous K3PO4 or Cs2CO3 in dioxane/H2O (~4–5:1). Default prioritizes dtbpf/K3PO4; base_rules enumerate frequently winning alternatives (P(tBu)3–Pd G3, XPhos–Pd G3, CataCXium A–Pd G3, and dppf variants). Modifiers re-rank for hard substrates (aryl chlorides, ortho-blocked, five-member heteroaryl) and lab symptoms (hydrodehalogenation, boronate dimer). Includes an 'hte_supply' section with screenable 6-pack and stock definitions for 1 µmol scale provisioning.

applies_if.expr: (Ar-Br OR Ar-Cl OR Ar-F OR Ar-I OR Ar-OMs OR Ar-OTf OR Ar-OTs OR Arom-Br OR Arom-Cl OR Arom-F OR Arom-I OR Arom-OMs OR Arom-OTf OR Arom-OTs OR Vinyl-Br OR Vinyl-Cl OR Vinyl-F OR Vinyl-I OR Vinyl-OMs OR Vinyl-OTf OR Vinyl-OTs) AND (Ar-B(OH)2 OR Ar-Bpin OR Arom-B(OH)2 OR Arom-Bpin OR Vinyl-B(OH)2 OR Vinyl-Bpin OR aryl_boron_reagent_present)

default_rule.description: General starter for sp2–sp2 Suzuki; robust across many substrates.

base_rules.name: P(tBu)3–Pd G3 / K3PO4 (hard substrates)
base_rules.description: Excellent for hindered aryl chlorides and electron-poor boronates; fast at elevated T.

reactant_features.expr: (Ar-Cl OR Arom-Cl OR Vinyl-Cl) OR ortho_1 OR ortho_2plus OR ortho_hindered OR electron_poor_aryl OR electron_poor_boronate_present

base_rules.name: dtbpf / K3PO4 (most frequent hit)
base_rules.description: General, scalable; good for broad aryl bromide/iodide and many aryl chloride cases.

reactant_features.expr: (Ar-Br OR Ar-Cl OR Ar-F OR Ar-I OR Ar-OMs OR Ar-OTf OR Ar-OTs OR Arom-Br OR Arom-Cl OR Arom-F OR Arom-I OR Arom-OMs OR Arom-OTf OR Arom-OTs OR Vinyl-Br OR Vinyl-Cl OR Vinyl-F OR Vinyl-I OR Vinyl-OMs OR Vinyl-OTf OR Vinyl-OTs) AND (Ar-B(OH)2 OR Ar-Bpin OR Arom-B(OH)2 OR Arom-Bpin OR Vinyl-B(OH)2 OR Vinyl-Bpin OR aryl_boron_reagent_present)

base_rules.name: XPhos–Pd G3 / K3PO4
base_rules.description: Dialkylbiaryl phosphine platform; reliable on aryl bromides and many chlorides.

reactant_features.expr: (Ar-Br OR Arom-Br OR Vinyl-Br OR Ar-Cl OR Arom-Cl OR Vinyl-Cl) OR heteroaryl_present

base_rules.name: dtbpf / Cs2CO3 (stronger base variant)
base_rules.description: Alternative base that often ranks highly; useful when K3PO4 underperforms.

reactant_features.expr: (Ar-Br OR Ar-Cl OR Ar-F OR Ar-I OR Ar-OMs OR Ar-OTf OR Ar-OTs OR Arom-Br OR Arom-Cl OR Arom-F OR Arom-I OR Arom-OMs OR Arom-OTf OR Arom-OTs OR Vinyl-Br OR Vinyl-Cl OR Vinyl-F OR Vinyl-I OR Vinyl-OMs OR Vinyl-OTf OR Vinyl-OTs) AND (Ar-B(OH)2 OR Ar-Bpin OR Arom-B(OH)2 OR Arom-Bpin OR Vinyl-B(OH)2 OR Vinyl-Bpin OR aryl_boron_reagent_present)

base_rules.name: CataCXium A–Pd G3 / Cs2CO3
base_rules.description: Frequently near the top; complementary to XPhos/P(tBu)3 choices.

reactant_features.expr: (Ar-Br OR Arom-Br OR Vinyl-Br OR Ar-Cl OR Arom-Cl OR Vinyl-Cl)

base_rules.name: dppf / K2CO3 (mild fallback)
base_rules.description: Lower basicity; try for base-sensitive partners or when hydrolysis observed.

reactant_features.expr: boc_present OR acetal_present OR silyl_ether_present OR ester_present

when: (Ar-Cl OR Arom-Cl OR Vinyl-Cl) OR ortho_1 OR ortho_2plus OR ortho_hindered
modifiers.suggest: Prefer P(tBu)3–Pd G3 or XPhos–Pd G3 at 100–110 °C; increase catalyst to 2.0 mol% if sluggish.
Keep dtbpf and XPhos in top slots; avoid overly polar co-solvents early; maintain H2O ~20–25% v/v.
Favor dtbpf or P(tBu)3 systems; ensure thorough degassing; shorten reaction time to limit protodeboronation.
Add TBAB 0.5–1.0 equiv and/or lower temperature by 10–15 °C.
Reduce base strength/equiv, increase organic fraction (e.g., dioxane/H2O 9:1), and consider dppf/K2CO3.
Improve exclusion of air; lower catalyst loading to 0.5–1.0 mol%; use freshly prepared boronate; consider neop-boronate surrogate.
